title: Tilted
description: Crossbows, unlimited crossbows, but no crossbows.
body:
A Minecraft mod about crossbows. Adds leaning, aiming down sights, scopes, barrels, skins - a LOT of skins - and gives a use to the fletching table! :D

The main features of this mod are split into 3 parts:
- Crossbow Focus Mode
- Fletching Table
- Smithing Table

## Crossbow Focus Mode

Allows you to lean, Aim Down Sights and have more control over your aim.

## Fletching Table

Allows you to pick attachments to put on your crossbow, affecting it's stats.

### Barrels 

- Suppressor
Silences crossbow sounds & arrow trial.
  
- Extended Barrel
Increases power, but increases spread.
  
- Flash Hider
Greatly reduces spread.
  
- Compensator
Greatly decreases charge time.

### Scopes

- Iron Sights
Fast ADS time, but minimal zoom.
  
- Magnified A
Slower ADS time, but more zoom.
  
- Magnified B
Hides crosshair when aiming.
  
- Telescopic
Significant zoom, but impaired vision.
  
- Micro-scope
errrrrrrr.........

## Smithing Table

Choose between a LOT of skins to put on your crossbow! Recieve crates with a rare chance, with them being randomly added to *any* loot-table with a small chance to drop. Simply play the game normally and crates should come rolling in!

![A player holding the "Hyperdeath" crossbow skin.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dc2c11770a2862596d92edb8fc067e46700dd72.png)
![Two players holding the "Nostalgia" crossbow. One player is leaning.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f644a31ca55771344baff5948e3601e49616691a.png)

All skins use string alongside a crossbow in a smithing table to skin the crossbow, except for one.
The "Ice" smithing template allows you to dye your crossbow any dye color (except for a few).
